name: Elimelech
bio: Elimelech is Naomi's husband and the father of Mahlon and Chilion. Facing famine in Bethlehem, he moves his family to the country of Moab in search of food, but he dies there early in the story, leaving Naomi a widow in a foreign land. Though he has no recorded words or actions beyond this decision, his death sets the whole account in motion, and his name and inheritance become the very things Boaz later acts to "redeem" and preserve.
